card.name: Early words in a new narrative sentence
card.fires_on: Scattered words early in a general-web sentence, such as a comma after a short clause, a determiner plus noun like 'The temperature', or a verb like 'enjoy'. The pole is strongest where a frequency or habit word could plausibly come next.

modes.label: Subject nouns after The/A
modes.description: A noun or adjective right after a determiner at the start of a sentence.

modes.label: Punctuation after a clause
modes.description: A comma or parenthesis that ends a short clause in narrative text.
modes.example: I can call to mind only one instance when I saw him in uniform<<,>> and one other when I heard of his

modes.label: Feeling or liking verbs
modes.description: A verb or adjective of feeling right after the subject.
modes.example: I<< enjoy>> watching Shakespeare but I, like many other

card.writes: It suppresses Chinese words meaning 'often' or 'many times', so it discourages frequency adverbs in what follows.
card.plain: It fires on ordinary early words in a sentence and makes frequency words like 'often' less likely to come next.
